name: Mythic Spellpower
body:
Mythic Spellpower (Sp)
Source Mythic Adventures pg. 18
You have a pool of magical power you can draw upon for casting mythic spells (see Chapter 3). Up to twice per day, you can use this power to cast a mythic spell without expending any uses of mythic power. You can select this ability up to three times; each time you do, you gain two additional uses of this ability per day.
